1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions and other requirements for bulkhead straight coupling assembly 
used in oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1 . 

3. Assembly Details — A bulkhead straight coupling assembly consists of ferrules ( conforming to 
IS : 8802-1978 'Specification for ferrules for oil-hydraulic couplings' ), coupling nut ( conforming to 
IS : 8803-1978 'Specification for coupling nuts for oil-hydraulic couplings' ), bulkhead straight body, 
(conforming to IS : 9768-1981 'Specification for bulkhead straight body for oil-hydraulic couplings' ) 
and lock nut [conforming to Indian Standard 'Specification for lock nuts for oil-hydraulic coupling' 
( under preparation )]. 

4. General Requirements — For details not covered in this standard reference shall be made to 
IS : 8805 (Partl)-1978 'General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic 
systems : Part I General'. 

5. Designation — A bulkhead straight coupling assembly of light series L for outside diameter of 
tube 6 mm and conforming to this standard shall be designated as : 

Bulkhead Straight Coupling L6 IS : 9769 



EXPLAN ATO R Y NOTE 
In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following standards: 

BS 4368 Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes 

Part 1 : 1972 Heavy series (metric). 

Part 3 : 1974 Light series (metric). British Standards Institution ( BSI ). 

DIN 2353-1966 Non-soldered taper-bush type pipe unions; complete unions and survey. 
Deutsches Institut fur Normung ( DIN ).
